lines: Mallika R Iyer, Promoter Group, holds 1,234,500 shares before the offer and is not selling in it.
Retained shares are valued at up to ₹166.90 crore (estimate, valued at offer price); shares, not cash, unlocked on 9 Sep 2026.
Conversation angle: the shares unlocked 67 days ago, so the value stays in shares until they choose to act.
